description: iss_48ea8171 (2026-09-20). Returns the stored model x effort table -- Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score, real USD cost-per-task, the seed-or-run-derived relative_cost_multiplier, acceptance state, measured_at and the per-cell staleness window -- with each cell annotated is_fresh (measured inside its window at as_of) and servable (accepted AND fresh). By default only accepted cells are returned; include_unaccepted=true also returns pending_crosscheck, crosscheck_conflict and withdrawn cells so a reviewer can see what the catalog is waiting on. Optional runtime and model filters. This read is what the hand-maintained ticket-header JSON on prj_937a6ec1 is replaced by. A read that fills the state layer's 100-row page is refused as catalog_too_large rather than served as a possibly truncated table.
embedding_description: Looking up the stored table of which AI models at which reasoning-effort settings score how well and cost how much per task, and seeing which rows are verified and recent enough that automated work assignment is allowed to rely on them.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: cells (rows plus is_fresh, servable), total_cells, servable_cells, as_of.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with servable_cells versus total_cells. When zero cells are servable, say the catalog is not yet usable by dispatch and name the acceptance states present rather than presenting scores as if they were live.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Pass a cell's capability_score scale (0-100 AA index) into select_dispatch_tier's required_score; do not hand-pick a cell from this read when the selector can be asked.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One ordered query over model_capability_cell through the state interface; no writes.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: catalog_too_large: the read filled a full page and may be truncated. state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For catalog_too_large, narrow with the runtime or model filter; the catalog should be a few dozen rows, so a full page means something is writing rows it should not.
